title: Consultant | Fusion Middleware - SOA/OSB | Hyderabad | Oracle
description:
**Position Title**

**Oracle WebLogic & Fusion Middleware Administrator**

**Experience**

**3–5 Years**

**Location**

Hyderabad / Mumbai

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Oracle WebLogic & Fusion Middleware Administrator** to manage, support, and optimize Oracle middleware platforms including **Oracle WebLogic Server**, **Oracle Fusion Middleware**, **Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)**, and **Oracle Analytics Server (OAS) / Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC)**. The ideal candidate should possess strong administration, troubleshooting, migration, performance tuning, and production support experience across Oracle middleware and analytics environments.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Oracle WebLogic & Fusion Middleware Administration**

* Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain Oracle WebLogic Server environments.
* Manage Oracle Fusion Middleware components across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments.
* Configure and administer Managed Servers, Clusters, Node Manager, Domain Administration, and Deployments.
* Monitor server health, JVM performance, thread utilization, memory consumption, and application availability.
* Perform troubleshooting of middleware-related incidents and root cause analyses.
* Implement security best practices including SSL certificates, authentication, authorization, and integration with LDAP/Active Directory.
* Support high-availability and disaster recovery configurations.

**Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) Administration & Support**

* Install, configure, and administer ODI repositories and agents.
* Support ODI load plans, scenarios, schedules, and integrations.
* Monitor ETL jobs and resolve execution failures.
* Assist development teams with ODI performance tuning and deployment activities.
* Perform repository backups, migrations, and upgrades.
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues involving Oracle databases and source/target systems.

**Oracle Analytics Server (OAS) / Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC)**

* Administer and support OAS/OAC environments.
* Manage semantic models, data connections, datasets, and security configurations.
* Support report/dashboard deployments and migrations.
* Monitor analytics platform performance and optimize resource utilization.
* Troubleshoot report failures, connectivity issues, and authentication problems.
* Collaborate with BI developers and business stakeholders for issue resolution.

**Operations & Support**

* Provide L2/L3 production support and participate in on-call rotations.
* Perform system health checks and capacity planning.
* Create and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs, and technical documentation.
* Automate routine administrative tasks using Shell scripting, WLST, Python, or other automation tools.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, database, cloud, and application teams during upgrades and deployments.
  

  

**Required Technical Skills**

**Core Skills**

* Oracle WebLogic Server Administration (11g, 12c, 14c)
* Oracle Fusion Middleware Administration
* Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) Administration
* Oracle Analytics Server (OAS)
* Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC)
* Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM)

**Operating Systems**

* Linux (RHEL, Oracle Linux, CentOS)

**Databases**

* Oracle Database 11g/12c/19c/21c
* Strong SQL knowledge

**Scripting & Automation**

* Shell Scripting
* Python
* WLST (WebLogic Scripting Tool)

**Security & Configuration**

* SSL Configuration
* LDAP / Active Directory Integration
* Identity & Access Management concepts

**Cloud Exposure (Preferred)**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
* OAC Administration in Cloud environments
* Hybrid and Cloud Migration projects
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in Oracle Middleware Administration.
* Hands-on experience supporting enterprise-critical WebLogic and Fusion Middleware environments.
* Experience in ODI administration and ETL support.
* Experience administering OAS and/or OAC platforms.
* Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle Middleware certifications.
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) certifications.
* Exposure to DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Git, Ansible, or Terraform.
* Experience in migration projects from OBIEE to OAS/OAC.
  

  
  

**Key Competencies**

* Production Support & Incident Management
* Performance Tuning
* Middleware Upgrades & Patch Management
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery
* Automation & Scripting
* Customer & Stakeholder Management
* Problem Solving and Root Cause Analysis

title: Database Administrator, Specialist
description:
**About Vanguard**
  
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.

  

**Vanguard India**

Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.

**Role Summary**

At Vanguard, technology is integral to helping our clients reach their personal goals. We depend on IT 24/7 to run our investors’ assets. That puts your expertise in Technology Operations at the heart of our business.

As a Database Administrator, you will be joining the Database Operations team supporting Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server and AWS database technologies (Postgres, DynamoDB, etc.). You will work with application developers, fellow DBA’s, and IT leadership to improve the efficiency, resiliency, production stability, automation, and reliability of Vanguard’s database infrastructure. The Database Operations team is primarily responsible for ensuring the operational availability/recoverability of all enterprise database platforms. The team is also responsible for administration/maintenance, upgrades/patching, performance tuning and completion of database requests from internal customers.

**Responsibilites**

* Ensure backup, recovery, security, availability, maintenance and performance of enterprise database technology.

* Create and maintain backup and recovery jobs.

* Resolve database issues and help to determine root cause.

* Perform administration, installation, upgrade, configuration, and patch management of all enterprise database technology.

* Perform on-call support on a rotational basis.

* Provide support during normal business hours to developer requests on a rotational basis.

* Recommend database technology features/functions to application developers.

* Assist with testing and evaluating IT vendor products.

* Review application designs for compliance with production acceptance requirements.

* Provide key technical input and expertise in large scale projects.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of experience as a database administrator, data modeler, business systems analyst, developer, or in a similar role involving enterprise data platforms

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

* Minimum of five years database administrator experience with Oracle, SQL Server or AWS (Postgres, DynamoDB)

* Certification in Oracle, SQL Server, or AWS, preferred but not required.

* Excellent written and oral communication skills, including interviewing and presentation skills.

* Strong relationship management, analytical, problem solving and organizational skills.

* Broad knowledge of the financial services industry.

* Ability to effectively multi-task.

* Flexibility, strong decision-making skills and effective time management skills.

* Proven ability to work with attention to detail under tight time constraints.

**Working knowledge and experience with some or all of the following**:

* MS Windows and/or Linux (Redhat) based operating systems

* Virtualization – VMware

* Distributed Computing Hardware Technologies

* Network Technologies – SDN, DNS, Ethernet Fabrics, Firewalls, Load Balancers, WAN, WiFi, etc.

* Directory Services – Active Directory/LDAP

* Backup and disaster recovery testing

* Job scheduling (Control-M)

* ITIL (Incident/Problem Management, CMDB) (ServiceNow)

**The ideal candidate should have working knowledge of:**

* DBA best practices and concepts: database backup & recovery, database performance tuning, database monitoring, and maintenance.

* Hands on experience of Oracle, SQL Server and AWS (Postgres, DynamoDB) database technologies.

* Troubleshoot complex systems to identify bottlenecks (SQL, IO, hardware, query related, etc.) and resolve database related issues.

* Ability to support multiple releases (e.g., Oracle 12c/18c/19c, Microsoft SQL Server 2016/2019, etc).

* Designing databases and data modeling concepts.

* Automation and scripting skills; PowerShell, Shell Scripting, PL/SQL, T-SQL, etc.

* Working knowledge of Cloud Providers & Solutions / AWS preferred.

* Great communication and documentation skills that leads to internal problem resolutions documents, lessons learned, how to, and knowledge transfer.

* Strong skills with troubleshooting, researching and resolving blocking/deadlocking, connectivity issues, data corruption, security issues etc.

**Location**

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

**Our mission**

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

  

**Our commitment to you**

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:

**Financial wellness**
  
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.

**Physical wellness**
  
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.

**Personal wellness**
  
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

**How we work**

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Sr.Manager Hospital Billing (Cash & Insurance)
description:
Senior Hospital Billing Manager – Cash Billing, Insurance Billing & Insurance Empanelment

**Department:** Cash & Insurance Billing  
**Designation:** Senior Hospital Billing Manager  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Industry:** Healthcare / Hospital  
**Reporting To:** Hospital Operations Head / General Manager / Management  
**Experience:** 5–8 years in hospital billing, insurance billing, and empanelment, preferably with managerial experience.

1. Job Summary

The Senior Hospital Billing Manager is responsible for overseeing the complete hospital billing operations, including cash billing, insurance billing, corporate billing, TPA coordination, and insurance empanelment. The role involves ensuring accurate billing, timely claim submission, effective revenue management, denial reduction, and compliance with hospital policies and insurance guidelines.

The position requires strong knowledge of hospital billing software, insurance processes, cash collection, claim settlement, and coordination with clinical, finance, front office, and insurance departments.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Cash Billing Management

* Supervise all cash billing activities for OPD, IPD, emergency, diagnostics, pharmacy, and other hospital services.
* Ensure accurate billing of consultations, procedures, investigations, surgeries, room charges, and other hospital services.
* Monitor daily cash collections, card payments, UPI transactions, and other payment modes.
* Ensure proper reconciliation of daily collections with billing reports and finance records.
* Monitor bill cancellations, refunds, discounts, concessions, and credit notes in accordance with hospital policies.
* Ensure all discounts and concessions are approved by authorized personnel.
* Monitor pending bills, outstanding payments, and unbilled services.
* Ensure proper preparation and submission of daily billing and collection reports to management.
* Identify billing discrepancies and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure compliance with hospital billing procedures and financial controls.

B. Insurance and TPA Billing Management

* Manage the complete insurance billing process for cashless and reimbursement cases.
* Coordinate with insurance companies, Third-Party Administrators (TPAs), and corporate clients.
* Ensure timely submission of pre-authorization requests for planned and emergency admissions.
* Verify patient insurance eligibility, policy validity, coverage, exclusions, and applicable limits.
* Coordinate with doctors, nursing staff, medical records, pharmacy, and other departments to obtain the necessary documentation.
* Ensure accurate preparation and submission of final bills, discharge summaries, investigation reports, prescriptions, and other supporting documents.
* Monitor claim submissions, query responses, approvals, deductions, and settlements.
* Follow up on pending claims, delayed payments, short settlements, and rejected claims.
* Analyse claim rejections and deductions and implement corrective actions to minimize revenue loss.
* Ensure compliance with insurance company and TPA billing guidelines, agreed package rates, and contractual terms.
* Maintain proper records of insurance claims, outstanding amounts, approvals, and settlements.
* Coordinate with the finance department for insurance receivables reconciliation.
* Ensure timely resolution of billing queries raised by insurance companies and TPAs.
* Monitor insurance-related discharge processes to minimize delays for patients.

C. Insurance Empanelment and Corporate Tie-Ups

* Identify and coordinate with insurance companies, TPAs, corporate organizations, and other healthcare payers for hospital empanelment.
* Handle the complete empanelment process, including application preparation, document submission, follow-ups, and agreement execution.
* Prepare and maintain hospital documents required for empanelment, including registrations, licences, certifications, infrastructure details, doctor profiles, and other supporting records.
* Coordinate with insurance companies and TPAs for hospital inspections, audits, and credential verification.
* Negotiate and coordinate with management regarding package rates, tariffs, payment terms, and contractual conditions.
* Review empanelment agreements, tariff structures, package rates, exclusions, and billing guidelines before implementation.
* Coordinate with management and the legal department for agreement review and renewal.
* Maintain an updated database of empanelled insurance companies, TPAs, corporate clients, and their respective agreements.
* Monitor agreement expiry dates and initiate renewal processes well in advance.
* Coordinate with insurance companies for tariff revisions and addition of new medical procedures and services.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with insurance representatives, TPA officials, and corporate HR teams.
* Identify opportunities to increase insurance and corporate patient volumes.

D. Revenue Cycle Management and Outstanding Follow-Up

* Monitor the complete revenue cycle from patient registration and billing to claim submission and final payment.
* Review daily, weekly, and monthly billing and collection performance.
* Track insurance and corporate receivables and ensure timely follow-up.
* Prepare ageing reports for outstanding claims and unpaid invoices.
* Coordinate with the finance team to reconcile insurance receivables and payment records.
* Identify revenue leakages arising from missed charges, incorrect tariffs, unauthorized discounts, and documentation errors.
* Monitor claim settlement timelines and escalate long-pending cases to the concerned authorities.
* Develop strategies to reduce billing errors, claim rejections, and outstanding receivables.
* Ensure proper documentation and audit trails for all financial transactions.
* Support internal and external audits relating to billing, insurance claims, and collections.

E. Team Management and Coordination

* Supervise billing executives, cash billing staff, insurance coordinators, and empanelment personnel.
* Allocate duties and responsibilities to team members and monitor their performance.
* Train staff on hospital billing software, insurance procedures, tariff structures, and documentation requirements.
* Ensure adequate staffing and smooth functioning of billing operations across shifts.
* Conduct regular reviews of billing accuracy, claim processing, collections, and pending cases.
* Coordinate with the following departments:
* Front Office and Patient Registration
* Finance and Accounts
* Medical Records Department (MRD)
* Pharmacy
* Nursing Department
* Doctors and Consultants
* Operations and Administration
* Corporate and Marketing Departments
* Resolve patient billing complaints and insurance-related grievances professionally.
* Ensure adherence to hospital policies, confidentiality requirements, and departmental SOPs.

F. Hospital Billing Software and MIS Reporting

* Ensure effective use of hospital information systems (HIS/HMS) and billing software.
* Monitor correct tariff mapping, package configuration, billing entries, and insurance coding where applicable.
* Ensure accurate recording of cash, insurance, and corporate transactions.
* Generate and analyse daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
* Prepare reports covering:
* Daily cash collections.
* OPD and IPD billing.
* Insurance and corporate billing.
* Cashless pre-authorizations.
* Claims submitted and settled.
* Pending insurance claims.
* Claim rejections and deductions.
* Outstanding receivables and ageing.
* Discounts, refunds, and concessions.
* Empanelment status and agreement renewals.
* Present billing and revenue performance reports to management.
* Recommend improvements in billing processes, reporting accuracy, and revenue collection.

3. Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, Hospital Administration, or a related field.
* MBA in Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, or Finance is preferred.
* Additional training or certification in hospital revenue cycle management or medical billing is an advantage.

4. Required Experience

* 5–8 years of experience in hospital billing, insurance billing, and revenue cycle management.
* Previous experience handling a hospital billing team in a multispecialty hospital is preferred.
* Practical experience in cashless insurance processing, TPA coordination, corporate billing, and insurance empanelment is essential.
* Experience handling insurance claim rejections, deductions, outstanding receivables, and settlement follow-ups.
* Knowledge of hospital billing software and MIS reporting.

5. Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of hospital cash and insurance billing procedures.
* Knowledge of insurance companies, TPAs, and cashless authorization processes.
* Experience in insurance empanelment and corporate tie-ups.
* Strong financial reconciliation and analytical skills.
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
* Team leadership and staff management capabilities.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, MIS reports, and hospital billing software.
* Ability to handle patient billing disputes and insurance escalations.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Senior Hospital Billing Manager will be evaluated based on the following:

S. No.Performance IndicatorExpected Outcome1Cash Billing AccuracyMinimal billing errors2Daily Cash Reconciliation100% reconciliation and timely reporting3Insurance Claim SubmissionTimely submission of complete claims4Pre-Authorization ProcessingTimely processing and follow-up5Claim Rejection RateContinuous reduction in avoidable rejections6Insurance OutstandingReduction in ageing receivables7Claim SettlementImproved collection and settlement timelines8Insurance EmpanelmentAchievement of approved empanelment targets9Billing ComplaintsTimely resolution of billing-related complaints10MIS ReportingAccurate and timely submission of reports11Revenue LeakageIdentification and prevention of billing losses12Team PerformanceImproved productivity and billing accuracy

*Note: Specific numerical targets should be established by management based on hospital size, payer contracts, claim volumes, and existing performance.*

7. Authority and Accountability

The Senior Hospital Billing Manager will be responsible for:

* Supervising daily billing operations and staff performance.
* Monitoring billing accuracy and collection reconciliation.
* Escalating unusual discounts, refunds, and billing adjustments for approval.
* Coordinating with insurance companies and TPAs regarding claims and settlements.
* Recommending insurance empanelment opportunities and tariff revisions.
* Ensuring proper documentation and compliance with hospital policies.
* Reporting billing discrepancies, revenue losses, and operational challenges to management.

8. Expected Deliverables

The employee is expected to ensure:

* Smooth and accurate cash and insurance billing operations.
* Timely processing and submission of insurance claims.
* Effective follow-up of pending claims and outstanding receivables.
* Expansion and maintenance of insurance and corporate empanelments.
* Reduction in avoidable claim rejections and billing discrepancies.
* Accurate daily collection reports and monthly revenue MIS.
* Improved coordination between billing, finance, clinical, and administrative teams.
* Continuous improvement in the hospital's revenue cycle and financial performance.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
Overview:

**Job Title:** Senior SQL Database Administrator  
**Experience:** 10–12 Years  
**Location:** Hyderabad (Office / Rotational)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Senior SQL Database Administrator with 10–12 years of experience to lead the design, optimization, and automation of enterprise-scale database systems. This role requires deep expertise in performance tuning, large database management (10TB+), and building automation frameworks that integrate on-premises and AWS environments. The ideal candidate will adopt an “infrastructure as code” mindset and drive scalable, high-performance data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Database Administration & Maintenance**

* Manage, monitor, and maintain SQL Server databases to ensure high availability, performance, and security.
* Design and support complex replication topologies to maintain data consistency across distributed environments.
* Perform regular health checks, system audits, and capacity planning.

**Performance Tuning & Optimization**

* Conduct advanced performance tuning and bottleneck analysis across CPU, memory, and storage layers (NVMe/EBS) for very large databases (VLDBs).
* Perform wait state analysis and optimize storage I/O performance.

**High Availability & Disaster Recovery**

* Design, implement, and manage SQL Server Always On Availability Groups.
* Troubleshoot high-latency transactional replication issues in high-throughput systems.
* Establish and maintain robust backup and disaster recovery strategies.

**Automation & Scripting**

* Develop self-service automation solutions for development teams (e.g., automated database refreshes, schema validation).
* Build and maintain cross-platform automation frameworks using PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
* Implement automated compliance checks and health monitoring for large-scale environments.

**Database Migration & Upgrades**

* Architect and execute migration strategies for large databases (10TB+) from on premises to AWS (EC2/RDS) with minimal downtime. Utilize tools and techniques such as Log Shipping, Mirroring, and AWS DMS.
* Leverage Delphix for data virtualization and masking to streamline non-production data provisioning.

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Deploy and manage SQL Server databases in AWS environments, including RDS and EC2.
* Ensure adherence to cloud best practices for scalability, security, and cost optimization.

**Monitoring & Troubleshooting**

* Proactively monitor database performance and resolve incidents.
* Use monitoring tools such as Foglight, DataDog, CloudWatch, and Redgate.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive solutions.

**Collaboration**

* Collaborate with application development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams.
* Provide database design guidance and support development initiatives.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of experience as a SQL Server DBA.
* Proven experience managing large-scale databases (10TB+).
* Strong expertise in:
* SQL Server performance tuning (execution plans, indexing, query optimization)
* Always On Availability Groups
* SQL Server Replication
* Backup and recovery strategies
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting for automation.
* Experience with Delphix (data virtualization and masking).
* Strong knowledge of AWS database services.
* Experience in database migrations and upgrades.
* Solid understanding of database security and compliance practices.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience with CommVault for backup and recovery.
* Working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure (Azure SQL, Managed Instances).
* Familiarity with DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines.

**Soft Skills**

* Ability to translate complex technical database challenges into actionable business insights for stakeholders and provide technical mentorship to junior team members.
* Proven ability to maintain composure and lead technical resolution during high-pressure production outages and complex multi-wave cloud migrations.
* A strategic mindset focused on 'Automation First' - proactively identifying manual bottlenecks and architecting long-term scalable solutions rather than quick fixes.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
**Senior Database Administrator**

**Job Summary**

Senior Database Administrator responsible for enterprise database administration across PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server, and MySQL environments. Proven experience in database installation, upgrades, patching, performance tuning, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, replication, cloud database support in Azure and AWS, security administration, automation scripting, and operational support within incident, change, and problem management frameworks.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in high-availability architecture, replication, platform engineering, security hardening, automation, incident response, and operational excellence within large-scale enterprise environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain enterprise database platforms, including PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server and MySQL technologies.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are a fast-growing technology startup preparing new products for production. We're looking for a hands-on **Database Platform Engineer** to own our PostgreSQL databases on AWS end to end: keeping them fast, reliable and secure at high concurrency, building the data pipelines that feed them, and automating how they are deployed and changed. You'll work closely with our principal engineer and backend team, and your decisions will shape the platform as it scales.

Key responsibilities

**Database administration**

* Own PostgreSQL on AWS RDS / Aurora in production, including high availability, replication and failover.
* Design and test backup and point-in-time recovery to meet defined RPO and RTO targets.
* Tune performance using execution plans, pg\_stat\_statements and Performance Insights; manage indexes, partitions, vacuum and bloat.
* Configure RDS parameter groups and connection pooling (PgBouncer / RDS Proxy) for high-concurrency workloads.
* Plan and run zero-downtime schema changes, data migrations and major version upgrades.
* Review database designs from developers for performance, integrity and security.

**Data engineering**

* Build and maintain data pipelines (ETL/ELT, CDC) using Python, SQL and AWS services.
* Move data reliably between transactional databases, event streams and analytics stores.

**DevOps and automation**

* Provision and manage database infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Automate database deployments through CI/CD pipelines using Flyway or Liquibase.
* Set up monitoring, alerting and dashboards with CloudWatch and Grafana; lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Enforce database security: access control, encryption, auditing and secrets management.
* Automate routine operations with Bash and Python scripts.

Must-have skills

* 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration in production, including databases of 1 TB or more.
* Strong experience with AWS RDS or Aurora PostgreSQL: parameter groups, Multi-AZ, read replicas, snapshots and upgrades.
* Proven experience with backup, PITR and restore, plus performance tuning and lock troubleshooting under high concurrency.
* Experience delivering zero-downtime schema changes and data migrations.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* CI/CD for database changes (Flyway, Liquibase, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or AWS CodePipeline).
* Strong SQL plus scripting in Python and Bash; comfortable on Linux.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**About CleanHarbors**

  

Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6\.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by **Mr. Alan S. McKim**.

  

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 25,000 employees and has over 750 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.

  

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
